name: engram-monorepo
description: Local-first, markdown-native memory for AI agents — tiered memory, Ebbinghaus decay, consolidation.
author: Blake Stone

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @engram/core && npm run build --workspace engram && npm run build --workspace @engram/mcp && npm run build --workspace @engram/panel
scripts.build:lib: npm run build --workspace @engram/core && npm run build --workspace engram && npm run build --workspace @engram/mcp
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/mcp && npm run lint --workspace @engram/panel && npm run typecheck:smoke
scripts.typecheck:smoke: tsc --allowJs --checkJs --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --noUnusedLocals --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --skipLibCheck scripts/smoke.mjs
